Milestone Journey
9 Sep 2016 forum

Five Members, One Vision

Formed as a WhatsApp group to link Karassery residents and gulf expatriates. Membership crossed 100 within a month; first medical aid granted.

2017 menu_book

Bharanaghadana & Motto

Adopted the written Constitution and the everlasting motto "ഞങ്ങളുണ്ട് നിങ്ങളോടൊപ്പം" (We Stand by You). Launched Disha 2017 youth guidance.

2018 water_damage

Society Registration & Relief

Successfully registered as an official society. Mobilised extensive food and emergency relief during the severe Kerala monsoon floods.

2019 – 2021 health_and_safety

Unified Samithi & Health

Consolidated committees into unified Bharana Samithi. Maintained pulse oximeters, home grocery deliveries, and lockdown online fests.

2022 – 2024 home_pin

Sahayanidhi & NG Square

Constructed houses for bereaved families, revitalised voluntary Sahayanidhi fund, and inaugurated the public NG Square park on Gandhi Jayanthi.

Reaching 10 years of brotherhood. Continuing monthly support for vulnerable families and renewing our pledge for democratic harmony.

Official Health Appeal • 26 Oct 2026

NG Appeals for Support for Child’s Medical Treatment

Nellikuth, 26 October 2026: NG Koottayma had earlier informed its members about a child from our locality who is suffering from a rare spinal cord-related illness. The matter was discussed thoroughly at the Bharana Samithi meeting held on 6 October 2026, following which members were also informed through the verified NG WhatsApp channel.

The child is scheduled to travel to NIMHANS Hospital, Bengaluru, in the coming month for specialized surgery and treatment. The family is expecting a minimum expenditure of approximately ₹3 lakh, covering the surgery, several weeks of recovery stay in Bengaluru, medicines, and medical tests.

Recognising the financial difficulties faced by the family, NG appealed to all members and well-wishers to contribute whatever amount they could afford. Every contribution, irrespective of its size, makes a meaningful difference and helps the family meet the expenses of the child's treatment.

Official Helpline Note:

Please reach out to the official Bharana Samithi desk through our contact section below for verified account routing without intermediate charges.

Contact Office
Community Safety • 22 Oct 2026

Anti-Drug Warning Banners Installed in Nellikuth

Nellikuth, 22 October 2026: NG Koottayma has installed two warning banners as part of its grassroots efforts to discourage substance abuse in the locality and protect the younger generation.

The initiative was implemented in accordance with a resolution adopted at the Bharana Samithi's online meeting held on 16 October 2026. The warning banners were installed at the entrance to Puyorakkunnu in Akkaraparamba and along Thondimmal Road.

The banners aim to warn individuals—including local residents, visitors, and outsiders—against engaging in illicit activities in the serene hamlet.

Protecting the younger generation is a shared social responsibility. NG urges all members to promptly inform relevant statutory law enforcement authorities if they notice suspicious activities, while strictly reminding members not to take the law into their own hands.
Civic Amenity • Gandhi Jayanthi

NG Square & Community Seating

The development of NG Square, including its adjoining resting and seating facility in Nellikuth, was created entirely through voluntary member subscriptions and physical labor.

Inaugurated on 2 October (Gandhi Jayanthi Day), the square provides a clean, shaded space for elders, youth, and workers to congregate, engage in constructive dialogues, read periodicals, and foster communal harmony away from screens.
Governance Charter

NG Bharanaghadana Summary

Adopted on 9 September 2017 with amendments approved in General Body sessions (2019, 2023, 2024), the Bharanaghadana establishes:

  • Article 1: Unity and fellowship across Wards 1 and 2 of Karassery Grama Panchayat.
  • Article 2: Absolute non-discrimination based on caste, faith, or political affiliations.
  • Article 3: Administration by a democratically elected Bharana Samithi and transparent auditing by the Finance Committee.
  • Article 4: Priority allocation to medical distress, student guidance, and sudden emergencies through Sahayanidhi.
Eligibility Guidelines

Joining NG Koottayma (Clause 5)

If you meet the membership eligibility criteria specified in Clause 5(1) of the Bharanaghadana:

  • Resident or native of Nellikuth locality (in-between Wards 1 & 2 of Karassery Grama Panchayat), or working expatriate from the locality.
  • Agreement to uphold the constitution, maintain harmony, and avoid partisan political conflict within the group.
  • Willingness to support the Sahayanidhi and participate in collective social and educational activities.

We warmly welcome you to submit the contact form below or reach our secretariat.
